title: Lost Mary Nera15K Cherry Cola Prefilled Vape Pods
description: The Cherry Cola Lost Mary Nera15K Prefilled Pod recreates the taste of a classic soda favourite. Sweet and juicy Cherry runs through the inhale, while fizzy Cola notes bring a tangy edge. Together, they deliver a nostalgic blend that’s lively, sweet, and refreshing from first puff to last. Each pack includes one 2ml Prefilled Pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, plus a 15ml Refill Pod that automatically replenishes the pod as you vape. This setup supports up to 15,000 puffs depending on use and removes the need for messy refills or coil changes. Built with a 0.6ohm mesh coil, the pod provides consistent vapour production and clear flavour definition throughout. Designed exclusively for the Lost Mary Nera30K Prefilled Pod Kit, installation is quick and mess-free: simply click the pod and refill pod into place and you’re ready to go. How to Use: 1. Remove all packaging and protective film. 2. Separate the 2ml prefilled pod and 10ml refill container. 3. Push the refill container into the pod until it clicks securely. 4. Attach the pod to your Nera30K device and remove the silicone plug from the mouthpiece. 5. Vape and enjoy. Once the e-liquid runs out, simply swap in a new Nera15K pod pack from a selection of 20 incredible Lost Mary flavour profiles.
